answer.summary: Li says people mistake world models for video generation or passive video-watching, overlooking spatial intelligence: making sense of a 3D or 4D world from 2D inputs.

sections.heading: The mistake
sections.content: Li says spatial intelligence is “not just about videos”: the world is not passively watching videos go by. Treating it as flat 2D video misses the deeper task of making sense of a 3D or 4D world from 2D information.
